name: Benign — Windows executables (PE) of this machine
description: Every PE file installed under /usr (UEFI loaders, Wine and Mono libraries, Python launchers…), recognised from its bytes and scanned where it is (read-only, no copy). Few on a plain Linux server: for a real Windows goodware set, add one with `rulezet-tester add-set` (README).
source: the machine that runs the tests
